title: "Seasonal activity"
---

{{< include _sample_warning.qmd >}}

When are tagged birds detected? Each cell is one hour of one day; the colour is how
many distinct tags were heard. Rows run **noon to noon** so that a night is one block,
because most migrants fly at night. Times are local to the farm (America/New_York) and
labelled as such; everything is stored in UTC.
